item.title: Tennessee Children’s Hospital Renamed After Dolly Parton
item.description: Beloved American icon Dolly Parton, who ain't dead yet, celebrated her 80th birthday last month. Today, she announces a partnership with a children's hospital that's near where she grew up in Tennessee. The Knoxville facility formerly known as East Tennessee Children’s Hospital will now be known as Dolly Parton Children's Hospital.
